# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop owner downloads the report as an XLSX file (requested by Haruto, TASK-016; blocked by ADR 0011 until Mira supersedes it).

# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: ready

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".

## Decision (2026-10-21): keep_as_is

- ADR 0011 (docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md, Accepted) says the export is CSV only; no XLSX until a newer record supersedes it.
- Mira's message, "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy", is a wish, not a ruling. It does not mention XLSX or ADR 0011, so it does not supersede it. No XLSX was added.
- To unblock: Mira must decide explicitly to allow XLSX (a new superseding ADR confirmed by her). Until then Haruto's accountant can open the CSV in their spreadsheet tool (not verified with Haruto).
- Outcome of this task is open: XLSX is deferred, see story map.
